en: Sepia-toned photograph of a quiet European street lined with attached three‑ to four‑story buildings featuring shuttered windows and modest shopfronts at ground level. The architecture is 19th‑century urban style, with simple classical detailing around windows and doors. A few pedestrians and a cart are visible in the distance, and the street appears relatively empty. There is no visible printed caption or border title on the image side.
